newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - DeKalb EPS view raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DeKalb EPS view raised.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Monday she raised her fiscal 1997 earnings estimate for seed and agricultural company DeKalb Genetics Corp to $1.42 a share from $1.35.
-- Earlier, DeKalb reported stronger than expected earnings for its fiscal first quarter, with a profit of $0.12 a share, compared with a loss of $0.01 a year ago.
-- DeKalb shares at midday were up two at 60-3/4.
-- Wittenburg added that DeKalb indicated it is poised to meet its goal of increasing its share of the U.S. and Canadian seed corn market by a half-point to one point.
-- DeKalb holds about 11 percent of the U.S. and Canadian seed corn market.
-- DeKalb said its earnings for the fiscal first quarter reflected strong results internationally, particularly in Argentina.
